coreMemory.english: v. to say what someone or something is like
coreMemory.structure: describe something as /dɪˈskraɪb sʌmθɪŋ æz/（把某物描述为）；describe what happened /dɪˈskraɪb wʌt hæpənd/（描述发生了什么）；describe in detail /dɪˈskraɪb ɪn dɪteɪl/（详细描述）；difficult to describe /dɪfəkəlt tu dɪˈskraɪb/（难以描述）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ can to describe → ✅ can describe；❌ to describeing → ✅ to describe

commonErrors.note: 情态动词 can 后直接接动词原形，不加 to。
不定式 to 后接动词原形；不要把不定式和 -ing 形式混合。

coreMemory.example: How would you describe your ideal weekend?
coreMemory.exampleChinese: 你会怎样描述理想的周末？
